title: catalog
description: The Shipley Farms product catalog, as documented in docs/API.md. Each title and description is written for the person reading tools/validate_catalog.py's report, so it says what the field is and why it matters in plain words.

@type.title: file type (@type)
@type.description: It must be ItemList, the schema.org list type every integration expects to read.

numberOfItems.title: product count (numberOfItems)
numberOfItems.description: Integrations read this instead of counting, so it must be a whole number.

x_shipley_provenance.title: provenance block (x_shipley_provenance)
x_shipley_provenance.description: It says when the file was made, so integrations can tell how old the prices are.

generated_at_utc.title: generation time (generated_at_utc)
generated_at_utc.description: It must be a UTC time written like 2026-09-26T00:59:05Z, so integrations can tell how old the prices are.

itemListElement.title: product list (itemListElement)
itemListElement.description: It must be a list, with one entry per product.

listItem.title: list entry
listItem.description: Each entry in the product list must hold one product under item.

product.title: product
product.description: Each entry in the product list must be a product with its details filled in.

@type.title: type (@type)
@type.description: It must be Product, the schema.org type integrations look for.

sku.title: product code (sku)
sku.description: Every product needs one, because other systems use it to tell products apart.

name.title: name
name.description: It is the name shoppers see.

url.title: product page address (url)
url.description: It must be a full web address on shipleyfarmsbeef.com, starting with https://, so links to the product work wherever the catalog is shown.

category.title: category
category.description: Integrations group products by it, for example Dry-Aged Steaks or Ground Beef.

brand.title: brand
brand.description: Every product carries the Shipley Farms brand.

name.title: brand name
name.description: Every product carries the Shipley Farms brand.

description.title: description
description.description: It is the text shoppers read about the product.

image.title: picture address (image)
image.description: It must be a full web address starting with https://, or the picture will not load on other sites.

x_shipley_catch_weight.title: sold-by-weight flag (x_shipley_catch_weight)
x_shipley_catch_weight.description: It must be true or false, because integrations use it to label the price as an estimate.

offer.title: price details (offers)
offer.description: It must hold the price and its currency.

price.title: price
price.description: Prices are in US dollars and must be more than zero.

priceCurrency.title: currency
priceCurrency.description: The farm sells in US dollars only, and integrations assume it.

url.title: price page address
url.description: It must be a full web address on shipleyfarmsbeef.com, starting with https://.
